faculty.name: Anthony Adornato
faculty.summary: Studies how journalists and newsrooms use social media and mobile devices, including newsroom social media policies and the influence of user-generated content on editorial decisions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记者与新闻机构如何使用社交媒体和移动设备，包括新闻编辑室的社交媒体政策以及用户生成内容对编辑决策的影响。

faculty.name: Claire Bai
faculty.summary: Examines the integration of artificial intelligence and data science into advertising and business marketing, drawing on industry experience in campaign and media analytics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能与数据科学在广告和商业营销中的融合应用，并借鉴其在广告活动与媒介分析方面的业界经验。

faculty.name: G Douglas Barrett
faculty.summary: Examines how contemporary art, experimental music, and sound address political economy, technology, race, gender, and sexuality using critical and interpretive humanities methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用人文学科的批判与阐释方法，研究当代艺术、实验音乐与声音如何回应政治经济、科技、种族、性别与性向等问题。

faculty.name: Jennifer Billinson
faculty.summary: Studies popular music, emotion, and digital culture, especially how popular music is used in responses to disaster and collective trauma, along with media representation and music history.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究流行音乐、情感与数字文化，尤其关注流行音乐在灾难与集体创伤应对中的作用，并涉及媒介再现与流行音乐史。

faculty.name: Nick Bowman
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive, emotional, physical, and social demands of interactive media such as video games, social media, and extended reality, and their roles in learning and well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电子游戏、社交媒体和扩展现实等互动媒介对认知、情绪、身体与社交的要求，以及其在非正式学习与心理健康中的作用。

faculty.name: Harriet Brown
faculty.summary: Practices and teaches magazine and health journalism, writing memoir and science journalism on food, eating disorders, body image, and family estrangement.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事并讲授杂志与健康新闻写作，撰写关于饮食、进食障碍、身体意象和家庭疏离的回忆录与科学新闻作品。

faculty.name: Nina Iacono Brown
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection of media law and technology, including First Amendment, intellectual property, internet, and social media law.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介法与技术的交叉领域，包括第一修正案、知识产权、互联网法与社交媒体法。

faculty.name: Makana Chock
faculty.summary: Studies how people process and respond to persuasive health and risk messages in mass media, social media, and virtual, augmented, and mixed reality, often using experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 常以实验方法研究人们如何处理和回应大众媒体、社交媒体及虚拟、增强与混合现实中的健康与风险说服信息。

faculty.name: Keonte Coleman
faculty.summary: Examines intersections of journalism, newsroom leadership, media representation, sports communication, and journalism education, with a focus on television news production.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻业、新闻编辑室领导力、媒介再现、体育传播与新闻教育之间的交叉，关注电视新闻制作。

faculty.name: Joshua P. Darr
faculty.summary: Studies campaign strategy, political knowledge, partisan polarization, and local news, including how changes in local newspaper coverage can slow polarization and rebuild trust.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究竞选策略、政治知识、党派极化与地方新闻，包括地方报纸报道的变化如何减缓极化并重建信任。

faculty.name: Beth Egan
faculty.summary: Applies machine learning to predict television audience retention and uses psychophysiological measures to study implicit responses to branded content.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用机器学习预测电视观众留存，并借助心理生理测量研究受众对品牌内容的内隐反应。

faculty.name: Imraan Farukhi
faculty.summary: Focuses on entertainment law and transactional practice in the film, music, and new media industries, including intellectual property and clearance.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注电影、音乐与新媒体产业中的娱乐法与交易实务，包括知识产权与版权清理。

faculty.name: Joshua Foust
faculty.summary: Studies how governments use video games for strategic communication, discourses of AI, and executive communication, using interviews, grounded theory, and critical analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用深度访谈、扎根理论与批判分析，研究政府如何利用电子游戏进行战略传播，以及人工智能话语与高管传播实践。

faculty.name: Ben Frahm
faculty.summary: Focuses on screenwriting craft and practice for film and television, drawing on professional experience selling and developing feature scripts.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注电影与电视剧本创作的技艺与实践，借鉴其出售与开发长片剧本的职业经验。

faculty.name: Aileen Gallagher
faculty.summary: Studies digital magazines and journalism education, drawing on experience as a magazine editor and expertise on the journalism industry.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字杂志与新闻教育，借鉴其杂志编辑经验及对新闻行业的专业认识。

faculty.name: Keith Giglio
faculty.summary: Focuses on screenwriting and producing, writing practical books on comedy blockbusters, video game narrative writing, and short scripts.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注剧本创作与制片，撰写关于喜剧大片、电子游戏叙事写作和短片剧本的实务著作。

faculty.name: Seth Gitner
faculty.summary: Focuses on visual journalism, photography, video, and multimedia and interactive storytelling, and develops new tools for visual education and professional media workflows.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注视觉新闻、摄影、视频及多媒体与互动叙事，并开发用于视觉教育和专业媒体工作流程的新工具。

faculty.name: Tula Goenka
faculty.summary: Produces documentaries and studies Indian cinema and human rights media, with a focus on South Asian storytelling and diaspora communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 制作纪录片并研究印度电影与人权媒体，关注南亚叙事与离散社群。

faculty.name: Brad Gorham
faculty.summary: Studies how media shape implicit biases and stereotypes of social groups, especially how language reveals cognition about difference, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 结合定量与质性方法，研究媒介如何塑造对不同群体的内隐偏见与刻板印象，尤其关注语言如何揭示对差异的认知。

faculty.name: Eric Grode
faculty.summary: Focuses on arts and cultural journalism and criticism, especially theater criticism and the history of Broadway musicals.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注艺术与文化新闻及评论，尤其是戏剧评论与百老汇音乐剧历史。

faculty.name: Jennifer Grygiel
faculty.summary: Draws on social media management and social listening experience to study social media and digital advocacy, including virtual gay-straight alliances.
faculty.summary_zh: 借鉴社交媒体管理与社交聆听经验，研究社交媒体与数字倡导，包括虚拟同性恋-异性恋联盟。

faculty.name: Roy Gutterman
faculty.summary: Studies communications law and the First Amendment, including free speech, freedom of information, student speech, and relations between courts and journalists.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播法与第一修正案，包括言论自由、信息自由、学生言论以及法院与记者之间的关系。

faculty.name: J. Christopher Hamilton
faculty.summary: Studies monetization, distribution, and financing of content across the television, film, and streaming industries, drawing on entertainment law and business practice.
faculty.summary_zh: 借鉴娱乐法与商业实务，研究电视、电影和流媒体产业中内容的变现、发行与融资。

faculty.name: Ken Harper
faculty.summary: Designs interactive and visual communication projects on global development, human rights, and atrocities through long-term collaborations in Liberia, South Africa, Israel, and Palestine.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过在利比里亚、南非、以色列和巴勒斯坦的长期合作，设计关于全球发展、人权与暴行议题的互动与视觉传播项目。

faculty.name: Gregory Heisler
faculty.summary: Practices and teaches photographic portraiture and image-making across editorial, documentary, and commercial photography.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事并讲授跨越编辑、纪实与商业摄影的肖像摄影与影像创作。

faculty.name: Keren Henderson
faculty.summary: Studies the sociology of U.S. newsrooms and the business and craft of news, using annual surveys of local TV newsrooms and audience research on short-form video news.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过地方电视新闻编辑室年度调查及短视频新闻受众研究，探讨美国新闻编辑室的社会学以及新闻的商业与技艺。

faculty.name: Shaina Holmes
faculty.summary: Focuses on visual effects and post-production practice for film and television, including VFX workflows and mentorship of artists.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注电影与电视的视觉特效与后期制作实践，包括特效工作流程与艺术人才培养。

faculty.name: Nausheen Husain
faculty.summary: Studies news coverage of post-9/11 War on Terror infrastructures and their effects on young Muslims, drawing on data- and documents-based investigative reporting.
faculty.summary_zh: 借助数据与文件驱动的调查报道，研究9·11后“反恐战争”体系的新闻报道及其对年轻穆斯林的影响。

faculty.name: Alexis Shore Ingber
faculty.summary: Bridges privacy law and media psychology, experimentally testing regulatory and design solutions for protecting privacy in emerging technologies such as emotion AI.
faculty.summary_zh: 融合隐私法与媒介心理学，通过实验检验在情感人工智能等新兴技术中保护隐私的监管与设计方案。

faculty.name: Hua Jiang
faculty.summary: Studies public relations management, internal communication, CSR and corporate social advocacy campaigns, and the role of AI and social media in public relations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共关系管理、内部传播、企业社会责任与企业社会倡导活动，以及人工智能与社交媒体在公关中的作用。

faculty.name: Rawiya Kameir
faculty.summary: Writes cultural criticism and journalism on music and popular culture, with interests in identity, diaspora, and queer Muslim communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 撰写关于音乐与流行文化的文化评论和新闻作品，关注身份认同、离散以及酷儿穆斯林社群。

faculty.name: Joel Kaplan
faculty.summary: Focuses on investigative and political journalism, communications law, and standards of fairness and transparency in public media.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注调查与政治新闻、传播法，以及公共媒体中的公正与透明标准。

faculty.name: Faren Karimkhan
faculty.summary: Studies social media influencer marketing, how influencer source factors shape consumer attitudes in fashion, and multicultural marketing among ethnic consumers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体网红营销、网红来源因素如何影响时尚消费者的态度与行为意图，以及面向少数族裔消费者的多元文化营销。

faculty.name: Jordan Kligerman
faculty.summary: Focuses on sports documentary and sports content production for social platforms, drawing on professional work with NFL Films and college athletics.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注体育纪录片和面向社交平台的体育内容制作，借鉴其在NFL Films与大学体育部门的职业经验。

faculty.name: Charisse L'Pree
faculty.summary: Examines how media affect identity, attitudes, and behaviors and how people use media to express themselves and connect, combining social psychology and critical media studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 融合社会心理学与批判媒介研究，探讨媒介如何影响身份认同、态度与行为，以及人们如何借助媒介表达自我与建立联系。

faculty.name: Taylor Vaughn Lasley
faculty.summary: Focuses on screenwriting and series development for television and streaming, drawing on professional writing experience.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注电视与流媒体剧集的剧本创作与开发，借鉴其职业编剧经验。

faculty.name: Kelly Leahy
faculty.summary: Applies educational research and a cultural and developmental lens to children's media, educational technology, digital games and toys, and media literacy.
faculty.summary_zh: 以教育研究及文化与发展视角研究儿童媒介、教育技术、数字游戏与玩具以及媒介素养。

faculty.name: Moon Lee
faculty.summary: Studies communication technology development and evaluation, health communication, media processes and effects, public relations, and cognition in decision-making.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播技术的开发与评估、健康传播、媒介过程与效果、公共关系以及决策中的认知过程。

faculty.name: Joon Soo Lim
faculty.summary: Studies CSR and corporate social advocacy communication, authenticity, and ethical issues in campaigns that use social media and AI, from fake news to brand safety and health risks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任与企业社会倡导传播、真实性，以及利用社交媒体和人工智能的传播活动中的伦理问题，涵盖假新闻、品牌安全与健康风险。

faculty.name: Regina Luttrell
faculty.summary: Studies the impact and responsible use of artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies in media and public relations, co-directing a synthetic media lab.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能等新兴技术在媒体与公共关系中的影响及负责任使用，并共同主持合成媒体实验室。

faculty.name: Colleen McEdwards
faculty.summary: Focuses on broadcast and digital storytelling and international news reporting, with academic training in education and technology management.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注广播与数字叙事及国际新闻报道，并具有教育与技术管理的学术背景。

faculty.name: Tim Mirabito
faculty.summary: Studies television newsroom dynamics, including newsgathering routines, burnout, mentorship, and leadership, as well as sports media coverage.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电视新闻编辑室的运作，包括采集新闻的常规、职业倦怠、指导与领导力，以及体育媒体报道。

faculty.name: Daniela Molta
faculty.summary: Advocates for community-wide digital literacy and more accountable digital advertising, drawing on industry experience in media planning and social media marketing.
faculty.summary_zh: 借鉴其媒介策划与社交媒体营销的业界经验，倡导社区层面的数字素养与更负责任的数字广告。

faculty.name: Greg Munno
faculty.summary: Focuses on civic and participatory journalism, data journalism, government reporting, and public records, with listed expertise in Q methodology.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注公民与参与式新闻、数据新闻、政府报道与公共记录，并列有Q方法方面的研究专长。

faculty.name: David Oh
faculty.summary: Studies Asian American representation and identity in popular and digital culture, othering in Korean media, and diasporic reception of Korean popular culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究流行与数字文化中的亚裔美国人再现与身份认同、韩国媒体中的他者化，以及离散群体对韩国流行文化的接受。

faculty.name: Rebecca Ortiz
faculty.summary: Studies how media and communication can improve the health and well-being of teens and young adults, developing and evaluating campaigns on sexual health, HPV vaccination, and sexual violence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介与传播如何促进青少年与年轻人的健康与福祉，开发并评估关于性健康、HPV疫苗接种与性暴力的传播活动。

faculty.name: Anne Osborne
faculty.summary: Examines how entertainment and sports media reinforce and challenge power, focusing on gender, sport fandom, and media discourses about intersex and transgender athletes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究娱乐与体育媒体如何强化或挑战权力结构，聚焦性别、体育粉丝文化以及关于间性与跨性别运动员的媒体话语。

faculty.name: Adam Peruta
faculty.summary: Studies how generative AI is reshaping the media business and professional practice, and how colleges and universities use social media for branding and recruitment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生成式人工智能如何重塑媒体商业与专业实践，以及高校如何利用社交媒体进行品牌建设与招生。

faculty.name: Steven Pike
faculty.summary: Studies public diplomacy practice, diplomatic identity, and place branding, using Q methodology to examine U.S. citizens' views of diplomacy and how practitioners from different nations perceive the profession.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用Q方法研究公共外交实践、外交身份与地方品牌，考察美国公民对外交工作的看法，以及不同国家的公共外交从业者如何看待这一职业。

faculty.name: Srividya Ramasubramanian
faculty.summary: Studies race and media, media literacy, implicit bias reduction, data justice, and intersectionality through critical media effects research and community-engaged scholar-activism.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过批判性媒介效果研究与社区参与式学者行动主义，研究种族与媒介、媒介素养、内隐偏见消减、数据正义与交叉性。

faculty.name: Alex Richards
faculty.summary: Focuses on data and investigative journalism, public records, and accountability reporting on government, crime, and the courts.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注数据与调查新闻、公共记录，以及针对政府、犯罪与法院的问责报道。

faculty.name: Milton Santiago
faculty.summary: Explores how emerging technologies such as generative AI and virtual production are changing how visual stories are conceived, created, and taught in cinematography.
faculty.summary_zh: 探讨生成式人工智能和虚拟制片等新兴技术如何改变电影摄影中视觉故事的构思、创作与教学。

faculty.name: Erika Schneider
faculty.summary: Studies the purpose and effects of crisis communication, using experiments to test how message strategies shape stakeholder trust and emotions, including during disinformation crises.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究危机传播的目的与效果，通过实验检验信息策略如何影响利益相关者的信任与情绪，包括虚假信息危机情境。

faculty.name: Michael Schoonmaker
faculty.summary: Focuses on media production in K-12 education, using filmmaking with teachers and students to support visual storytelling and urban school reform.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注中小学教育中的媒体制作，通过与师生合作拍片推动视觉叙事与城市学校教育改革。

faculty.name: Youngji Seo
faculty.summary: Takes a psychological approach to strategic communication, studying resilience, crisis recovery, and information processing in public relations and health risk communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 以心理学视角研究战略传播，关注公共关系与健康风险传播中的韧性、危机恢复与信息处理。

faculty.name: Michael O. Snyder
faculty.summary: Uses documentary photography and film to explore cultural heritage, environmental change, and human resilience, including how heritage sites adapt to climate change.
faculty.summary_zh: 以纪实摄影与电影探讨文化遗产、环境变化与人类韧性，包括文化遗产地如何适应气候变化。

faculty.name: Renée Stevens
faculty.summary: Designs motion graphics and augmented reality experiences, exploring how AR can help overcome learning disabilities and how design can serve social good.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计动态图形与增强现实体验，探索增强现实如何帮助克服学习障碍以及设计如何服务社会公益。

faculty.name: Bruce Strong
faculty.summary: Practices and teaches photo, video, and multimedia documentary storytelling, drawing on international photojournalism across nearly 80 countries.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事并讲授图片、视频与多媒体纪实叙事，借鉴其在近80个国家的国际摄影新闻经验。

faculty.name: Emily Sydnor
faculty.summary: Studies the political implications of incivility in mediated and interpersonal discourse and how people's attachments to U.S. states shape their political behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介与人际话语中不文明言论的政治影响，以及人们对美国各州的归属感如何塑造其政治行为。

faculty.name: Corey Takahashi
faculty.summary: Researches generational change in media and culture and how technology reshapes storytelling for creators and audiences across text, audio, and video.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介与文化中的代际变迁，以及技术如何在文字、音频与视频中为创作者与受众重塑叙事。

faculty.name: Robert Thompson
faculty.summary: Studies television and popular culture, including the history of prime-time television series.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电视与流行文化，包括黄金时段电视剧的历史。

faculty.name: Jodi Upton
faculty.summary: Focuses on data and investigative journalism, using databases and public records for accountability reporting.
faculty.summary_zh: 关注数据与调查新闻，运用数据库与公共记录开展问责报道。

faculty.name: Jason Webb
faculty.summary: Studies extended reality in education, creating XR learning content and examining remote instruction and how technology fosters student creativity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究扩展现实在教育中的应用，开发XR学习内容，并探讨远程教学以及技术如何激发学生创造力。

faculty.name: Lars Willnat
faculty.summary: Studies global journalism, political media effects, and public perceptions of news media in democracy through cross-national surveys and the American Journalist survey of U.S. journalists.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过跨国调查与“美国记者”全国调查，研究全球新闻业、媒介的政治效果以及公众对新闻媒体在民主中作用的认知。
